mapper.sql: issue_id, region_id, event_name, app_version, issue_type, severity, title, description, status, assignee, resolution, source_key, occurrence_count, last_detect_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT event_id AS eventId, event_name AS eventName, priority, report_terminal AS reportTerminal, create_by AS createBy, update_by AS updateBy FROM bi_tracking_event WHERE status = '0' AND report_terminal IN ('CLIENT', 'BOTH') ORDER BY event_id

SELECT event_id AS eventId, event_name AS eventName, priority, report_terminal AS reportTerminal, create_by AS createBy, update_by AS updateBy FROM bi_tracking_event WHERE status = '0' ORDER BY event_id
SELECT FROM bi_tracking_quality_issue WHERE status IN ('0', '1') AND region_id = #{regionId} ORDER BY FIELD(severity, 'HIGH', 'MEDIUM', 'LOW'), last_detect_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bi_tracking_quality_issue WHERE status = '0' AND region_id = #{regionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bi_tracking_quality_issue (region_id, event_name, app_version, issue_type, severity, title, description, status, assignee, source_key, occurrence_count, first_detect_time, last_detect_time, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{regionId}, #{eventName}, #{appVersion}, #{issueType}, #{severity}, #{title}, #{description}, '0', #{assignee}, #{sourceKey}, 1, NOW(), NOW(), #{createBy}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE severity = VALUES(severity), title = VALUES(title), description = VALUES(description), assignee = COALESCE(NULLIF(assignee, ''), VALUES(assignee)), occurrence_count = occurrence_count + 1, last_detect_time = NOW(), update_by = VALUES(create_by), update_time = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE bi_tracking_quality_issue SET status = #{update.status}, assignee = #{update.assignee}, resolution = #{update.resolution}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE issue_id = #{issueId} AND region_id = #{regionId}
